name: Diary
description: A sleek, cross-platform diary app that keeps your thoughts organized and secure. With a clean interface and powerful features, Diary is the perfect companion for capturing your daily moments and reflections.

features.title: Encrypted
features.description: Your diary entries are encrypted with AES-256, ensuring that only you can access your thoughts and memories.

features.title: Auto formatting
features.description: You can use {time} and {date} placeholders in your entries, and they will be automatically replaced with the current time and date when you save or press the auto-format button.

features.title: lightweight
features.description: Diary is designed to be lightweight and fast, ensuring a smooth experience without consuming excessive system resources.
